Ye Dongfeng, the supreme master of the world, was an inch away from the ethereal way(Becoming an immortal), but was calculated at a critical moment and reborn at the beginning of everything. In this life, Ye Dongfeng created a perfect Taoist heart. He slightly got up and pushed the world with awe-inspiring resources, turning his hands into clouds, making rain with his hands, and stepping over and crossing every difficulty with his own power. The regrets and unwillingness of the previous life were wiped out, and he became famous in the ancient times, and he became the holy lord with war as his way.

He got a doomsday salvation system. As long as he saves the world, he can have everything. He recruited top talents to build the Pan-Human Principle Guardian Association. He descended into the doomsday worlds as the guardian of human principles, allowing the whole world to admire him and worship him as a god. The ultimate natural disaster. The mutation frenzy. The whisper of the evil god. Thus, a huge organization spanning many worlds, taking the protection of human principles as its own responsibility and saving civilization from the fate of destruction, gradually appeared in the eyes of the world.

description.en:
Lin Feilu is an oscar-winning actress. Acting cute, slandering, feigning innocence, or playing the white lotus. Regardless, she wasn't a good person. She then died on her 27th birthday. She vowed, if there was a next life, she would be a good person. In the end, she transmigrated into a five-year-old princess of the great Lin Dynasty. Her imperial mother was not favored, her older brother was mentally challenged, and her life was constantly in danger, with having little to eat and trying to stay warm.

Lin Feilu: …You all forced me!
description.fr:
Lin Feilu est une actrice oscarisée. Faire la mignonne, médire, feindre l'innocence ou jouer les innocentes. Peu importe, elle n’est pas quelqu'un de bien. Elle meurt le jour de son 27e anniversaire en se jurant que si elle a une prochaine vie, elle serait une bonne personne. Elle se réincarne en une princesse de cinq ans de la grande dynastie Dalin. Sa mère, concubine impériale n'était pas favorisée parce son frère aîné souffrait d'une déficience mentale.
Lin Feilu, bien que déterminée à rester une bonne personne, va utiliser ses talents de manipulatrice pour retourner la situation de sa famille.

description.pt-br: Após ser demitido, Lin Yi acidentalmente recebe um “Sistema de Experiência de Carreira Completa”. Lin Yi conta com os vários acordos de trabalho e recompensas dadas pelo sistema. Com isso ele será capaz de alcançar gradualmente com sua ambição um caminho de riqueza, se tornando o todo poderoso líder que dominará o mundo.

description.en:
Mother always said to Qinran: "Your stepfather is from a famous family, your eldest brother is a genius, and your sister is a top student in her high school. You, a country bumpkin, don't embarrass them."

Everyone with status in the capital received a warning from Mr. Juan of the Cheng family: "Mr. Juan's wife is from the countryside and doesn't understand our current situation, and she has a bad temper. In short, everyone should be extra patient."

Until one day, when Master Juan was investigating a certain big boss, his men fell into a confused silence while looking at one of the waistcoats of his sister-in-law who claimed to know nothing…

description.en:
The almighty Demon Cultivator Xie Tian gave birth to a child during the demon king selection and lost his place as the demon king! Now at the bottom of the pit, he decides to bring his son Duoduo and get his man back from the succession and marriage ceremony of the righteous sect! Who is the father?!   
  
Bai Jing: Since you're already, then you won't be going anywhere else. I want both the father and the child!  
Xie Tian: Marriage? Sure. But I'm on top!

Suen, 19 ans, universitaire, est en couple depuis 1 an avec Shen Luo, designer, quand elle découvre de manière inattendue un secret incroyable, il a de super pouvoirs…une comédie douce et pétillante.  
  
—  
  
After dating for one year, my boyfriend suddenly confessed that he had a special ability! Not only does he use it anytime I ask, he can also be summoned at will!  
  
A cute yet forgetful girl and a handsome boyfriend with an ability—what kind of sweet and troublesome love story will unfold?

December 1, 2043 AD. The mysterious lifeform BABY invades Earth and takes control of a number of human hosts, parasitising them. The possessed bodies metamorphise into monsters called ‘Organos,’ which slaughter a great mass of humanity in a series of bloody massacres, bringing mankind to the brink of extinction. Thereafter, December 1 comes to be known as ‘Extinction Day.’ While battling an Organo, Elettra, the protagonist of the story, finds that her left hand has been infected by BABY. However, aside from a throbbing pain in her hand, nothing about the rest of her body changes. Elettra begins to search for other survivors, hoping to solve the mystery of BABY…

In the Heavens or on Earth, only I shall be immortal! In the vast Divine Lands, at the western border, upon the recommendation of his best friend, he began walking on a path he had never thought possible.  
  
 The Cloudlink Sect, as the ‘Final Path’ of the 7 main sects of the Divine Lands, on their sacred disciple acceptance ceremony that happens once every 5 years, took in a single 5th generation disciple who had a beggar-like bearing.   
  
With the gates of cultivation opened wide for him, will this bright and mischievous child be able to mature into a powerful Immortal that rules the world? Please find out in - Only I Shall Be Immortal

A frosty top-tier celebrity stylist vs. a deceptively innocent, low-tier internet star with rustic charm. 

One unexpected act of "red carpet revenge” catapults Chu Xia back into the spotlight, reborn with a brand-new identity. But the real game is only just beginning: a deadly match between “prey” and “predator.” 

Who will emerge as the true winner?

description.en: All it took was one meet-up, a simple meet-up with his MMO wife and suddenly he was dragged into the world of urban cultivation. Thus he believed that he would begin his journey as a cultivator in this urban world and live a life of overbearing dominance. However...why is life as a cultivator so hard and so impoverished? How come everyone's still playing the MMO even though they're piss poor? Wait a minute...playing the MMO is part of cultivation too?!

title.en: The Fresh Start of Elegant Beauty

description.en:
Millennia-old Chinese clothing culture intertwines the fantastical lives of two girls.

One day, Bai Tang, a freshman in university, accidentally "picked up" a girl named Zhu Lian, a quirky girl dressed in Tang dynasty attire who valiantly claimed to be from over one thousand years ago... From that moment on, Bai Tang's ordinary life takes a wild turn.

She was exploited, mistreated by her stepmother and stepsister. They were scum, insane, crazy. She became a tool for her sister's success. After dying from a painful death, she was reborn. In her previous life, she had a fiancee that she admired and loved for a long time, but he was cold and felt disgust toward her, which brought her pain and made her hopeless. But now, facing him again, she said while smiling: « Let break off the engagement, I don’t want this marriage anymore! » However this man wants to stay in a relationship with her— « Shang Zhen, you were already my person the day you were born. You want to break up? That’s too late »

description.en: Short story about a prince who met the captured son of the enemy's general.

A young girl plays truth or dare with her friends one evening and gets challenged to ask the first male that walks into the bar to give her his belt.  
This evening was meant to be her bachelorette party after making a deal with her adoptive mother. The deal they made was that if she agrees to an arranged marriage, she will get to continue her studies. In order to keep her education going, she sacrifices herself, but little did she know the identity of her fiancé…

I will conquer your stomach first and then conquer your mouth with my excellent cooking skills.
I can always handle both evil husband and nasty mother-in-law.
As for those ill-disposed sisters-in-law, just let them be jealous!

I’m not going to play with you~

biography.en: AKA: Mu Danfeng

description.en: My name is Qiu Kui, and I time-traveled! From the wonderful modern world to a poor, ancient village where there's no internet, and even electricity! Worst of all, my parents drowned themselves and my younger sister is physically challenged, and not forgetting the fact that our family is also in debt. I mean, seriously, how can I live under these circumstances! Thank goodness I time-traveled with a bag of groceries and daily necessities… But has anyone time-traveled with items like these? This is ridiculous!

title.en: Beast Taming: Starting with the Classic of Mountains and Seas, Sweeping Across the Globe

altTitles.zh: 全民御兽：开局山海经，横扫全球

description.en: Starting with the Classic of Mountains and Seas, Sweeping Across the Globe The era of Beast Masters has arrived globally, but the Great Xia is on the brink of collapse due to a break in ancient civilizations, with no one able to summon powerful beasts. The time-traveler Yang Yang starts by summoning the *Classic of Mountains and Seas*, using the legendary beasts from the mythic mountains and seas as his own! With terrifying talent and strength, Yang Yang leads the Great Xia to sweep across the world, crushing various nations. Everyone is shocked: he is not a Beast Master, but the “Beast Overlord” who stands above the heavens and earth! [Updated every Tuesday and Friday]
